title: Everyone In Our City Gets A Number At Birth. Mine Is 0.
description: The number above your head = years you have left. Mine is 0. Then one night every number in the city dropped to 1… 😳

scenes.narration: Everyone in our city is born with a number above their head. It's how many years you have left. Mine is *zero*.
My grandma has a three. My baby sister has a ninety one. Every birthday, your number goes down by one.
A zero has never happened before. Not once in five hundred years.
scenes.speaker: doctor

scenes.narration: The doctors said I wouldn't make it to my first birthday. I'm twelve now.
People cross the street when they see me. Like zero is *contagious*.
Then last night, every number in the city changed. At the exact same time.
Ninety one. Sixty. Three. They all dropped to *one*. Everyone's. Except mine.
And on the horizon, something huge started walking toward the city.
It walked past the police. Past the walls. Straight down our street.
At sunrise, it stopped. Right in front of me. And it *bowed*.
Zero was never how many years I had left. Zero meant: I'm the *only* one it can't touch.
Now it's waiting for my order. Do I send it away? Or let it take the city that hated me? Tell me.
